description: The newest large taker prints (trades above the tape threshold) with side, price, size and whether a tracked whale was the taker.

coin.description: Coin name as on Hyperliquid, e.g. BTC, ETH, kPEPE, xyz:TSLA (case-insensitive).

min_usd.description: Only prints of at least this many USD.

minutes.description: Look-back window in minutes (default 60; clamped to the order-flow history of the plan, the answer says when it was cut).

name: get_large_trades

error.description: Only on a failed call (isError: true): code, message and, from the API, status, param, doc_url, request_id.

meta.description: The API meta block: updatedAt, source (venues), sources, plan, delayMinutes, license, attribution (the credit line to show), access, warnings, restricted.

title: Large-trade tape
